name: BlockUX Workflow
author: WPRavix

sections.description:
Improve the WordPress block editor with cleaner editing UX, a streamlined right-click toolbar, text drag handles, and more.

Features

  • Cleaner block highlights for better structure readability.
  • Right-click toolbar with configurable visibility of supported actions.
  • Drag & drop handles in text blocks.
  • Optional editor UI cleanup tools for a more focused workspace.
  • BlockUX Workflow sidebar integrated into the block editor.
  • Expand editor content width (workspace mode).

The Pro version extends BlockUX Workflow with advanced layout and productivity features that are not included in the free version:

  • Responsive controls for individual blocks and elements.
  • Individual margin and padding adjustments for different devices.
  • Responsive font size controls for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Device visibility controls for hiding selected blocks or elements on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
  • Per-block responsive workflow tools for more precise layout control inside the editor.
  • Page Audit, a workflow assistant for reviewing layout inconsistencies, heavy custom styling, and potential responsive risks.

Usage

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Open the WordPress block editor.
  3. Open the BlockUX Workflow sidebar from the editor interface.
  4. Configure the available editor options and toolbar visibility.
  5. Work directly inside the editor canvas with the enabled BlockUX Workflow tools.

Notes

Language versions: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese / Brazil, Japanese
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/blockux-workflow directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the block editor and configure BlockUX Workflow from its sidebar.
sections.faq:
Who is BlockUX Workflow for?

BlockUX Workflow is built for WordPress users who work regularly in the block editor, including site owners, content creators, freelancers, agencies, and developers who want a more efficient editing workflow.

Does BlockUX Workflow affect the front end of my site?

The free version is focused on improving the editor experience and does not change the front-end appearance of your existing content.

Advanced responsive features, such as device-specific spacing, responsive font sizes, and hiding selected blocks or elements on specific devices, are part of the Pro version.

Will BlockUX Workflow slow down my website?

BlockUX Workflow is designed primarily to improve the editor workflow. The free version focuses on editor-side tools and does not add front-end layout effects to your site.

Could BlockUX Workflow change my existing website layout?

The free version does not modify existing page content or change your front-end layout. It provides editor workflow enhancements such as visual highlights, sidebar tools, workspace mode, text drag handles, and right-click toolbar features.

Responsive layout controls are available in the Pro version and are optional.

Can I use BlockUX Workflow if I am not a developer?

Yes. BlockUX Workflow is made to help both non-technical users and advanced users work more comfortably in the WordPress block editor.

Does the plugin replace my theme or page builder?

No. BlockUX Workflow is not a theme and is not a page builder replacement. It is a workflow enhancement plugin for the native WordPress block editor.

Can I use BlockUX Workflow on client websites?

Yes. BlockUX Workflow can be useful for freelancers and agencies who build or maintain WordPress websites for clients using Gutenberg.

Is there a learning curve?

Most features are designed to feel natural inside the editor. The goal is to make everyday actions more intuitive, not more complicated.

Is BlockUX Workflow a one-time setup plugin?

No. BlockUX Workflow is intended to improve your day-to-day editing workflow every time you work in the WordPress block editor.

Will BlockUX Workflow help me keep page design more consistent?

Yes. BlockUX Workflow helps improve visual structure inside the editor. The Pro version also includes Page Audit, which helps review layout inconsistencies, heavy custom styling, and potential responsive risks.
